# Protect.com

> > Protect.com is a comprehensive insurance quote comparison platform enabling side-by-side rate shopping across auto, home, and health insurance with personalized calculators and state-specific guidance.

Protect.com serves as an insurance marketplace aggregator, helping consumers compare quotes from top-rated providers like Progressive while providing detailed coverage requirements and savings strategies by state and vehicle type. The platform combines quote comparison tools with educational content on insurance regulations, minimum coverage requirements, and cost-saving tips.

## Key Topics

- Auto Insurance
- Home Insurance

- Coverage Guides

## Core Quote Comparison Tools

- [Protect.com Homepage](https://protect.com): Main entry point for comparing car, home, and health insurance quotes side-by-side
- [Auto Insurance Quotes](https://protect.com/car-insurance): Auto insurance quote comparison tool with top-rated providers
- [Home Insurance Quotes](https://protect.com/home-insurance): Home insurance quote comparison tool with rate shopping features
- [Health Insurance Quotes](https://protect.com/health-insurance): Health insurance quote comparison and affordable coverage options
- [Auto Insurance Rate Calculator](https://protect.com/car-insurance/rate-calculator): Personalized auto insurance rate calculator with quick estimates
